def run(_context):
    import json
    # Face 5 is the pocket floor (planar, Z=30mm, normal +Z, area=3578mm2)
    # This is the correct face for a pocket adaptive2d op - Fusion uses the floor
    # to determine pocket depth and the boundary is the outline of the pocket opening
    result = mb.add_operation(
        "Setup11",
        strategy="adaptive2d",
        tool=4,  # 1/2" 3Fl Carb TiCN - roughing tool
        geometry={"faces": [5], "type": "pocket"},
        name="Rough_Adaptive"
    )
    print("Operation:", result["operation"])
    print("Params:")
    print(json.dumps({k: v["expression"] for k, v in result["params"].items()}, indent=2))
